cross_run_read.answer: The direct spectra do not support the multi-modal/confused-sea hypothesis for high-delta windows.
cross_run_read.month_matched_caution: The heldout split keeps a modest narrower-band/longer-period signal under month matching; March weakens; West Coast broad-background shifts mostly disappear under month matching.
cross_run_read.next: If needed, add event-level clustering around specific top windows and inspect spectra visually, but the modal-count discriminator has already moved against the multi-modal label.
cross_run_read.positive_signal: High-delta windows are more consistent with organized coherent swell-like structure: longer-period energy, narrower energy width, lower spectral entropy, and higher concentration.
